nodes.name: digital_power
nodes.description: AMS1117-3.3 generates 3.3V rail for digital ICs from VIN_5V. LDO input and output require bypass capacitors. This module owns the VCC_3V3 rail.

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: ATmega328P MCU controlling DAC via I2C. MCU runs on 3.3V supply. PC4 (ADC4) and PC5 (ADC5) pins implement I2C (SDA, SCL). BOOT0 concept is not applicable (ATmega328P uses Reset pin). This module owns the I2C bus biasing (pull-up resistors).

nodes.name: dac
nodes.description: MCP4725 12-bit I2C DAC generates control voltage for amplifier bias network. Operates on 3.3V supply. A0 pin tied to GND for I2C address 0x60 (or appropriate address via resistor). This module's VOUT provides bias voltage.

nodes.name: VOUT
nodes.description: DAC analog output, rail-to-rail (0 to VDD).

nodes.name: VDD
nodes.description: Supply voltage (2.7-5.5V), also serves as DAC reference.

nodes.name: SDA
nodes.description: I2C data, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: SCL
nodes.description: I2C clock, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: A0
nodes.description: I2C address bit. VSS=0x60, VDD=0x61. Must not float.

nodes.name: analog_preamplifier
nodes.description: NE5532 dual op-amp. Channel 1 configured as non-inverting amplifier with gain determined by external resistor feedback network. DAC bias voltage enters channel-1 non-inverting input network. Channel 2 unused: IN2_P and IN2_N tied to mid-bias point (e.g., via resistor divider) to avoid floating. Powered by VIN_5V rail.
